title: Tones
description: Mandarin has four main tones plus a neutral tone. The same syllable changes meaning completely.

title: Basic word order
description: Chinese follows Subject + Verb + Object, and time words come before the verb.

title: Personal pronouns
description: Pronouns do not change for case. Add 们 to make the plural.

title: The verb 是 (to be)
description: 是 links two nouns. It is not used with adjectives.

title: The verb 有 (to have)
description: The negative of 有 is always 没有, never 不有.
rows: tā yǒu liǎng gè hái zi.
zhuō zi shang yǒu yì běn shū.
There is a book on the table.
Hay un libro sobre la mesa.

title: Negation: 不 and 没
description: 不 negates the present or habitual; 没 negates 有 and past events.
rows: wǒ cóng lái méi qù guo.

title: Yes / no questions with 吗
description: Add 吗 at the end of a statement to turn it into a question.
rows: nǐ shì zhōng guó rén ma?
A él le gusta el té.

title: Question words
description: The question word stays in the position of the answer; 吗 is not used with it.

title: Possession with 的
description: 的 links the owner to the thing owned. With close family it is often dropped.

title: Measure words
description: Every noun needs a measure word between the number and the noun.

title: Demonstratives: 这 and 那
description: 这 = this, 那 = that, 哪 = which. They need a measure word.

title: Numbers 0–20
description: Numbers are regular; 二 becomes 两 before a measure word.

title: 也 and 都
description: 也 means 'also' and 都 means 'all'; both come before the verb.
rows: wǒ men dōu shì xué sheng.

title: Adjectives with 很
description: An adjective used as a predicate normally takes 很, which often just means 'to be'.
rows: hěn piào liang de fáng zi

title: Location with 在
description: 在 comes before the place and means 'to be at / in / on'.
rows: tā zài xué xiào xué xí.
The book is on the table.
El libro está sobre la mesa.
I am going to the shop.

title: Time expressions
description: Time words come after the subject and before the verb.
rows: tā qù nián qù le zhōng guó.
He went to China last year.
Él fue a China el año pasado.

title: Days of the week
description: 星期 + number, from Monday to Sunday (Sunday is 星期天 or 星期日).

title: Modal verbs: 会, 能, 想, 要
description: Modal verbs come before the main verb and are not conjugated.
rows: I would like to drink tea.

title: The particle 了 (completed action)
description: Verb + 了 marks a completed action; the object usually follows.
rows: tā mǎi le yì běn shū.
zuó tiān wǒ qù le xué xiào.

title: Sentence-final 了 (change of state)
description: At the end of a sentence, 了 shows that the situation has changed.

title: The particle 过 (experience)
description: Verb + 过 means you have had the experience at some time.
rows: tā kàn guo zhè bù diàn yǐng.
nǐ chī guo zhōng guó cài ma?
wǒ cóng lái méi chī guo.

title: 正在 and 在 (progressive)
description: 正在 / 在 + verb shows an action happening right now, often with 呢.
rows: tā men zhèng zài chàng gē.

title: The particle 着 (continuous state)
description: Verb + 着 describes a state that continues, not an action in progress.
rows: qiáng shang guà zhe yì zhāng huà.
A picture hangs on the wall.
Un cuadro cuelga de la pared.

title: The complement of degree with 得
description: Verb + 得 + description tells how well or how much an action is done.
rows: nǐ wán de kāi xīn ma?

title: Comparison with 比
description: A + 比 + B + adjective means 'A is more … than B'.
rows: jīn tiān bǐ zuó tiān lěng.
Hoy hace más frío que ayer.
wǒ de shū bǐ nǐ de duō.
My books are more than yours.
Mis libros son más que los tuyos.
Él es más joven que yo.
I am not as tall as you.
No soy tan alto como tú.

title: Equality with 跟…一样
description: A 跟 B 一样 + adjective means 'A is the same as B'.
rows: wǒ gēn nǐ yí yàng gāo.
I am as tall as you.
tā gēn wǒ yí yàng dà.
He is the same age as me.
Él tiene la misma edad que yo.
zhè ge gēn nà ge yí yàng.
This one is the same as that one.
zhè ge gēn nà ge bù yí yàng.
This one is different from that one.

title: Cause and effect: 因为…所以
description: 因为 introduces the cause and 所以 the result; either half may be dropped.
rows: yīn wèi xià yǔ, suǒ yǐ wǒ méi qù.
Because it rained, I did not go.
yīn wèi tài lěng, wǒ men méi chū mén.
Because it was too cold, we did not go out.
Como hacía mucho frío, no salimos.
tā bìng le, suǒ yǐ méi lái.
He was ill, so he did not come.
Estaba enfermo, así que no vino.
nǐ wèi shén me bù lái?

title: Contrast: 虽然…但是
description: 虽然 concedes a point and 但是 gives the contrast.
rows: 虽然很累，但是我很开心。
suī rán hěn lèi, dàn shì wǒ hěn kāi xīn.
Although I am tired, I am happy.
虽然下雨，我们还是去了。
suī rán xià yǔ, wǒ men hái shì qù le.
Although it rained, we still went.
suī rán guì, dàn shì wǒ mǎi le.
Although it was expensive, I bought it.

title: Condition: 如果…就
description: 如果 introduces the condition and 就 introduces the consequence.
rows: 如果明天晴天，我们就去公园。
rú guǒ míng tiān qíng tiān, wǒ men jiù qù gōng yuán.
If it is sunny tomorrow, we will go to the park.
Si mañana hace sol, iremos al parque.
rú guǒ nǐ lái, wǒ jiù hěn gāo xìng.
If you come, I will be very happy.
rú guǒ xià yǔ, wǒ men jiù bú qù.
If it rains, we will not go.

title: Result complements
description: A verb plus a complement shows the result of the action.

title: Imminent action: 要…了 / 快要…了
description: 要…了 or 快要…了 shows something is about to happen.
rows: wǒ men kuài yào zǒu le.
The train is about to leave.
El tren está a punto de salir.
Él está a punto de llegar.

title: Simultaneous actions: 一边…一边
description: 一边…一边 shows two actions happening at the same time.
rows: 他一边吃饭，一边看电视。
tā yì biān chī fàn, yì biān kàn diàn shì.
wǒ yì biān zǒu, yì biān tīng yīn yuè.
I listen to music while walking.
tā yì biān chàng gē, yì biān tiào wǔ.

title: The more… the more: 越…越
description: 越 + adjective/verb, 越 + adjective/verb shows a growing change.
rows: yuè xué yuè yǒu yì si.
The more you learn, the more interesting it is.
Cuanto más aprendes, más interesante es.
tiān qì yuè lái yuè rè.
El tiempo es cada vez más caluroso.
The more he runs, the faster he goes.
Cuanto más corre, más rápido va.

title: Addition and exception: 除了…以外
description: 除了…以外 … 都 = except; 除了…以外 … 还/也 = besides.
rows: 除了他以外，大家都来了。
chú le tā yǐ wài, dà jiā dōu lái le.
除了中文以外，他还会英语。
chú le zhōng wén yǐ wài, tā hái huì yīng yǔ.
Besides Chinese, he also knows English.
Además del chino, también sabe inglés.
除了茶以外，我也喜欢咖啡。
chú le chá yǐ wài, wǒ yě xǐ huan kā fēi.
Besides tea, I also like coffee.
Además del té, también me gusta el café.

title: The 把 construction
description: 把 moves the object before the verb to show what is done to it: 把 + object + verb + result.
rows: wǒ bǎ shū fàng zài zhuō zi shang le.
I put the book on the table.
Puse el libro sobre la mesa.
tā bǎ mén guān shàng le.
qǐng bǎ chuāng hu dǎ kāi.
tā bǎ zuò yè zuò wán le.

title: The passive with 被
description: 被 + agent + verb marks the passive; the agent can be left out.
rows: shū bèi tā ná zǒu le.
The book was taken away by him.
El libro fue llevado por él.
wǒ de chē bèi rén tōu le.
chuāng hu bèi fēng chuī kāi le.
The window was blown open by the wind.
tā bèi lǎo shī pī píng le.
He was criticised by the teacher.
bēi zi bèi dǎ pò le.

title: Emphasis with 是…的
description: 是…的 highlights the time, place or manner of a past action.
rows: wǒ shì zuó tiān lái de.
It was yesterday that I came.
tā shì zuò huǒ chē qù de.
It was by train that he went.
zhè běn shū shì tā xiě de.
It was he who wrote this book.
Fue él quien escribió este libro.
nǐ shì shén me shí hou lái de?
When was it that you came?

title: Condition: 只要…就
description: 只要…就 means 'as long as … then …'.
rows: zhǐ yào nǐ nǔ lì, jiù néng chéng gōng.
As long as you work hard, you can succeed.
Con tal de que te esfuerces, puedes tener éxito.
zhǐ yào nǔ lì, jiù yǒu xī wàng.
As long as you try, there is hope.
Con tal de que lo intentes, hay esperanza.
zhǐ yào tā lái, wǒ jiù qù.
As long as he comes, I will go.
Con tal de que él venga, iré.

title: Necessary condition: 只有…才
description: 只有…才 means 'only if … then …'.
rows: zhǐ yǒu nǔ lì, cái néng chéng gōng.
Only by working hard can you succeed.
zhǐ yǒu nǐ qù, wǒ cái qù.
Only if you go will I go.
Solo si tú vas, iré yo.
zhǐ yǒu tā cái zhī dào.

title: Concession: 无论…都
description: 无论…都 means 'no matter what / whether … still'.
rows: 无论你去不去，我都要去。
wú lùn nǐ qù bú qù, wǒ dōu yào qù.
Whether you go or not, I will go.
wú lùn duō nán, wǒ dōu yào shì.
No matter how hard it is, I will try.
No importa cuán difícil sea, lo intentaré.
wú lùn shéi dōu yào zūn shǒu guī zé.
Everyone must follow the rules, whoever they are.
Todos deben seguir las reglas, sean quienes sean.

title: Not only… but also: 不但…而且
description: 不但…而且 adds a second, often stronger point.
rows: 他不但会英语，而且会汉语。
tā bú dàn huì yīng yǔ, ér qiě huì hàn yǔ.
He knows not only English but also Chinese.
Sabe no solo inglés sino también chino.
这个菜不但好吃，而且便宜。
zhè ge cài bú dàn hǎo chī, ér qiě pián yi.
This dish is not only tasty but also cheap.
Este plato no solo está rico sino que es barato.
她不但是老师，而且是作家。
tā bú dàn shì lǎo shī, ér qiě shì zuò jiā.
She is not only a teacher but also a writer.
No solo es profesora sino también escritora.

title: Even if: 即使…也
description: 即使…也 means 'even if … still'.
rows: jí shǐ xià yǔ, wǒ yě yào qù.
Even if it rains, I will go.
jí shǐ hěn lèi, wǒ yě yào wán chéng.
Even if I am tired, I must finish.
即使他来了，也来不及了。
jí shǐ tā lái le, yě lái bu jí le.
Even if he comes, it will be too late.

title: Since… then: 既然…就
description: 既然…就 means 'since it is the case that … then …'.
rows: 既然你来了，就一起吃饭吧。
jì rán nǐ lái le, jiù yì qǐ chī fàn ba.
Since you are here, let's eat together.
Ya que estás aquí, comamos juntos.
既然下雨，我们就在家吧。
jì rán xià yǔ, wǒ men jiù zài jiā ba.
Since it is raining, let's stay at home.
Ya que llueve, quedémonos en casa.
既然决定了，就不要后悔。
jì rán jué dìng le, jiù bú yào hòu huǐ.
Since you have decided, do not regret it.
Ya que lo has decidido, no te arrepientas.

title: Concession: 尽管…还是
description: 尽管…还是 means 'although … still'.
rows: jǐn guǎn hěn máng, tā hái shì lái le.
Although he was busy, he still came.
jǐn guǎn hěn nán, wǒ hái shì yào shì.
Although it is hard, I will still try.
Aunque es difícil, lo intentaré igualmente.
尽管下雨，他还是出去了。
jǐn guǎn xià yǔ, tā hái shì chū qù le.
Although it rained, he still went out.

title: Even: 连…都 / 也
description: 连…都/也 emphasises an extreme case: 'even …'.
rows: tā lián fàn dōu méi chī jiù zǒu le.
这个字连老师都不认识。
zhè ge zì lián lǎo shī dōu bú rèn shi.
Even the teacher does not know this character.
Ni siquiera el profesor conoce este carácter.
wǒ lián yì fēn qián yě méi yǒu.
I do not even have one penny.

title: Directional complements
description: Verbs of movement combine with 来 / 去 and 上, 下, 出, 过, 起 to show direction.
rows: tiān sè àn xià lái le.
qǐng bǎ shū ná guò lái.

title: Preference: 与其…不如 / 宁可
description: 与其…不如 = 'rather than … it is better to'; 宁可 = 'would rather'.
rows: 与其在家等，不如出去走走。
yǔ qí zài jiā děng, bù rú chū qù zǒu zou.
Rather than wait at home, it is better to go out.
En vez de esperar en casa, mejor salir.
与其求人，我宁可自己解决。
yǔ qí qiú rén, wǒ nìng kě zì jǐ jiě jué.
Rather than ask others, I would rather solve it myself.
Antes que pedir ayuda, prefiero resolverlo yo mismo.
与其买贵的，不如买实用的。
yǔ qí mǎi guì de, bù rú mǎi shí yòng de.
Rather than buy something expensive, it is better to buy something practical.
Antes que comprar algo caro, mejor algo práctico.

title: Concession: 固然…但是
description: 固然…但是 concedes a fact but introduces a stronger counterpoint.
rows: 钱固然重要，但是健康更重要。
qián gù rán zhòng yào, dàn shì jiàn kāng gèng zhòng yào.
Money is certainly important, but health matters more.
El dinero es ciertamente importante, pero la salud importa más.
固然很难，但是值得一试。
gù rán hěn nán, dàn shì zhí dé yì shì.
It is admittedly hard, but worth a try.
Es ciertamente difícil, pero vale la pena intentarlo.
他固然聪明，但是不够努力。
tā gù rán cōng ming, dàn shì bú gòu nǔ lì.
He is certainly clever, but not hard-working enough.
Ciertamente es listo, pero no se esfuerza lo bastante.

title: Reason: 之所以…是因为
description: 之所以…是因为 front-loads the result and then gives the reason.
rows: 他之所以成功，是因为他很努力。
tā zhī suǒ yǐ chéng gōng, shì yīn wèi tā hěn nǔ lì.
The reason he succeeded is that he worked hard.
La razón por la que tuvo éxito es que se esforzó mucho.
之所以迟到，是因为路上堵车。
zhī suǒ yǐ chí dào, shì yīn wèi lù shang dǔ chē.
The reason for being late is a traffic jam.
La razón de llegar tarde es un atasco.
她之所以生气，是因为你没告诉她。
tā zhī suǒ yǐ shēng qì, shì yīn wèi nǐ méi gào su tā.
She is angry because you did not tell her.
Está enfadada porque no se lo dijiste.

title: Extent: 以至于
description: 以至于 introduces an extreme result: 'so much that …'.
rows: 他太累了，以至于站着就睡着了。
tā tài lèi le, yǐ zhì yú zhàn zhe jiù shuì zháo le.
He was so tired that he fell asleep standing.
Estaba tan cansado que se durmió de pie.
声音太大，以至于我听不见。
shēng yīn tài dà, yǐ zhì yú wǒ tīng bu jiàn.
The noise was so loud that I could not hear.
Había tanto ruido que no podía oír.
他跑得太快，以至于没人追得上。
tā pǎo de tài kuài, yǐ zhì yú méi rén zhuī de shàng.
He ran so fast that no one could catch him.
Corrió tan rápido que nadie pudo alcanzarlo.

title: Let alone: 尚且…何况
description: 尚且…何况 means 'even … let alone …'.
rows: tā shàng qiě bú huì, hé kuàng wǒ ne?
Even he cannot do it, let alone me.
Ni siquiera él puede, y mucho menos yo.
专家尚且解决不了，何况我们。
zhuān jiā shàng qiě jiě jué bu liǎo, hé kuàng wǒ men.
Even experts cannot solve it, let alone us.
Ni los expertos pueden resolverlo, y menos nosotros.
大人尚且做不到，何况孩子？
dà rén shàng qiě zuò bu dào, hé kuàng hái zi?
Even adults cannot do it, let alone children.
Ni los adultos pueden, y mucho menos los niños.

title: Avoidance: 以免 / 免得
description: 以免 and 免得 introduce a negative purpose: 'so as not to …'.
rows: zǎo diǎn chū fā, yǐ miǎn chí dào.
Set off early so as not to be late.
Sal temprano para no llegar tarde.
jì xià lái, miǎn de wàng jì.
Write it down so as not to forget.
duō chuān diǎn, yǐ miǎn gǎn mào.
Wear more so as not to catch a cold.

title: Contrary to expectation: 反而
description: 反而 shows a result opposite to what was expected.
rows: yào chī le, bìng fǎn ér gèng zhòng le.
He took the medicine, but got worse instead.
他不但没生气，反而笑了。
tā bú dàn méi shēng qì, fǎn ér xiào le.
He did not get angry; on the contrary, he laughed.
No se enfadó; al contrario, se rió.
yuè shuì fǎn ér yuè lèi.
The more I sleep, the more tired I feel.
Cuanto más duermo, más cansado estoy.

title: Excess: 未免
description: 未免 softens a criticism meaning 'rather too …'.
rows: 你这样说未免太过分了。
nǐ zhè yàng shuō wèi miǎn tài guò fèn le.
Saying that is rather too much.
Decir eso es un poco excesivo.
zhè ge jià gé wèi miǎn tài gāo le.
This price is rather too high.
tā wèi miǎn tài zì xìn le.
Él es demasiado seguro de sí mismo.

title: Tentative suggestion: 不妨
description: 不妨 means 'might as well' and softens a suggestion.
rows: nǐ bù fáng shì shi kàn.
You might as well give it a try.
如果不知道，不妨问问他。
rú guǒ bù zhī dào, bù fáng wèn wen tā.
If you do not know, you might as well ask him.
Si no lo sabes, bien podrías preguntarle.
wǒ men bù fáng huàn gè fāng fǎ.
We might as well try another method.

title: Inevitability: 难免
description: 难免 means that something is hard to avoid: 'inevitably'.
rows: dì yī cì zuò, nán miǎn chū cuò.
Doing it the first time, mistakes are unavoidable.
Al hacerlo por primera vez, es inevitable equivocarse.
人多的地方难免有麻烦。
rén duō de dì fang nán miǎn yǒu má fan.
In crowded places trouble is inevitable.
En lugares concurridos los problemas son inevitables.
tā gāng lái, nán miǎn bù xí guàn.
He has just arrived, so it is natural he is not used to it.
Acaba de llegar, es natural que no esté acostumbrado.

title: Formal reason: 鉴于
description: 鉴于 introduces a formal consideration: 'in view of / given'.
rows: 鉴于情况紧急，我们必须马上行动。
jiàn yú qíng kuàng jǐn jí, wǒ men bì xū mǎ shàng xíng dòng.
Given the urgency, we must act at once.
Dada la urgencia, debemos actuar de inmediato.
鉴于他表现优秀，公司提拔了他。
jiàn yú tā biǎo xiàn yōu xiù, gōng sī tí bá le tā.
In view of his performance, the company promoted him.
En vista de su rendimiento, la empresa lo ascendió.
鉴于时间有限，我们就谈到这里。
jiàn yú shí jiān yǒu xiàn, wǒ men jiù tán dào zhè lǐ.
As time is limited, let us stop here.
Como el tiempo es limitado, terminemos aquí.

title: Register: 就…而言
description: 就…而言 frames the point of view: 'as far as … is concerned'.
rows: 就价格而言，这个很便宜。
jiù jià gé ér yán, zhè ge hěn pián yi.
As far as the price is concerned, this is cheap.
En cuanto al precio, esto es barato.
就能力而言，他完全可以胜任。
jiù néng lì ér yán, tā wán quán kě yǐ shèng rèn.
In terms of ability, he is fully capable.
En cuanto a la capacidad, es competente.
就我个人而言，我不同意。
jiù wǒ gè rén ér yán, wǒ bù tóng yì.
As far as I am concerned, I do not agree.
En lo que a mí respecta, no estoy de acuerdo.
